comparison.objective: Tune and lock a shock absorber versus orient and clamp an angle-grinder guard.
comparison.physical_skill: Both require stabilizing equipment, releasing a clamp, rotating a component, and reclamping; candidate uniquely uses a hex key and iterative dynamic feedback.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two acceptable impacts plus a post-lock drift test; record requires guard direction within 30 degrees, lever flat, grinder unmoved, and hands clear.
comparison.reason: Despite substantial shared adjustment primitives, the record tests a prescribed static orientation while the candidate tests dynamic commissioning from observed response. Candidate rebound, overload, and drift thresholds remain numerically undeclared.
